answer: Bonded stake at the oasis: each identity locks 500 POA for 3 epochs. A fraud proof slashes the full bond, so farming 1,000 sybils costs 500,000 POA. Honest stake emits a stable plume of yield; slashed fakes emit none. Fresh wallets must repeat the voyage from zero stake, paying full collateral again. Cost scales linearly per identity while attack payoff stays flat, so returns go negative first. Slashing makes each fake a self-funding liability, not a cheap clone.
